question.prompt: A and B are 100 km apart and travel toward each other at speeds of 30 and 20 km/h. After how many hours will they meet? (Unit: hours)

solutions.explanation: For a meeting problem, the sum of the distances equals the sum of the speeds multiplied by the time. Thus, \((30+20)t=100\), so \(t=2\).
solutions.title: Meeting equation
